panel.enters: DEWA potable supply, DM treated sewage effluent (TSE) reuse, intermittent stormwater pulses.
panel.accumulates: Amenity water bodies, irrigated landscape, surface runoff that does not evaporate.
panel.unmeasured: Cumulative salt applied to the landscape versus what leaves it.

panel.enters: Network leakage, irrigation return flow, infiltrating stormwater — all arriving with their dissolved salt load.
panel.accumulates: Salinity and rising water tables. This is where the inversion is happening.
panel.unmeasured: Almost everything. No single authority owns monitoring, fate, or mass balance here.

panel.enters: Direct aquifer storage and recovery (ASR) injection of treated water; slow decadal downward signal from above.
panel.accumulates: Injected water of differing chemistry from the native formation; strategic reserve volume.

panel.enters: Continuous desalination brine discharge; lateral groundwater discharge from the shallow system.
panel.accumulates: Elevated near-shore salinity; an advancing saline interface pushing back inland.
panel.unmeasured: The coupled feedback between brine discharge and the inland saline front.

inflows.label: DEWA potable
inflows.tooltip: Potable supply from desalination, distributed by DEWA. Source: DEWA.

inflows.label: DM TSE reuse
inflows.tooltip: Treated sewage effluent reused for landscape irrigation. TSE Na ~252 mg/L, Cl ~750 mg/L (max). Source: GDM Enviro Consulting water-balance analysis.

inflows.label: Stormwater pulse
inflows.tooltip: Intermittent stormwater pulses; episodic but high-volume recharge events. Source: GDM Enviro Consulting water-balance analysis.

inflows.label: DEWA ASR injection
inflows.tooltip: Aquifer storage and recovery: direct injection of treated water into the deep aquifer. Source: DEWA.

inflows.label: Desalination brine
inflows.tooltip: Continuous hypersaline brine discharge to the Gulf. Gulf is ~25% saltier than typical seawater. Source: Arab Center DC.

internalFlows.label: network leakage 77,000–93,000 m³/day
internalFlows.tooltip: Distribution network losses infiltrate the shallow subsurface. 77,000–93,000 m³/day. Source: GDM Enviro Consulting water-balance analysis.

internalFlows.label: irrigation return ~25% of applied
internalFlows.tooltip: Roughly a quarter of applied irrigation water returns to the shallow system, carrying salt. Source: GDM Enviro Consulting water-balance analysis.

internalFlows.label: decadal
internalFlows.tooltip: Slow downward migration of the shallow signal toward the deep aquifer over decadal timescales.

internalFlows.label: lateral discharge
internalFlows.tooltip: Lateral groundwater discharge from the shallow system toward the coast.

internalFlows.label: advancing
internalFlows.tooltip: Rising saline interface advancing inland from the marine compartment.
